# FAI Drone Permission
FAI is the world governing body for air sports. The more and more popular Drone sports are part of the FAI air sports family 
[Purchase the permission](https://droneracing.aero/registration) [Extend the permission](https://droneracing.aero/extend)
## Permission
To participate in FAI sanctioned category 2 drone events the competitor is required to have either an FAI Sporting Licence issued by his/her national FAI member (list of members at <http://www.fai.org/members> ) or an FAI Permission for Drone Racing, which can be obtained through these pages. The permission is valid for the calendar year of 2026 only. To obtain the permission, you must register and make a payment of 10 CHF via our online payment system. Your registration details will be sent to your national FAI member organization for information. By registering you agree that FAI and its member organization may contact you.
[Purchase the permission](https://droneracing.aero/registration) [Extend the permission](https://droneracing.aero/extend)
![](https://droneracing.fai.org/images/licence1.jpg) ![](https://droneracing.fai.org/images/licence2.jpg)
## Events
Many of the FPV Drone races in 2026 qualify as FAI Drone Racing World Cup events. For 2026, currently 15 such events are sanctioned by the FAI and registered on the FAI calendar. The list of 2026 Drone Racing World Cup events can be found from the FAI website
[View event calendar](http://www.fai.org/world-cups/drone-racing)
